classification.difficultyReason: Each part requires recognising an unshifted reciprocal graph and substituting one labelled point to determine its coefficient.

content.prompt: Find the equation of the following.

spec.sourceRegion: Printed page 154, left column, question 28; left graph beneath the shared 28–29 instruction.
spec.description: Two reciprocal branches in quadrants I and III. Black coordinate axes have positive-direction arrowheads and italic x and y labels. mathematics.axisScale: Equal coordinate units on both axes.

spec.answerVisibility: The graph and labelled point are permanent student-visible givens. The equation is not printed on the question diagram.
